Extracts response metadata from HTTP headers (etag, server, content-language)

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(nil)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `https://example.com`
	result, err := pkg.Scrape(engine, url)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.StatusCode)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ResponseMeta.Etag)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ResponseMeta.LastModified)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ResponseMeta.Server)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ResponseMeta.ContentLanguage)
}
```
